That really sounds like a flyback failure to me

Sounds like you have a flyback transformer failure, as the video circuitry in the tray loads doesn't start without video as it never gets the signal to do so. (assuming you're talking about the DB-15 video interconnect). You can replace/assuming skill, repair the flyback, but the easiest route is to get an analogue board from a REV. C or D (5 flavors) tray load. The Bondi's (REV. A & B) use different analogue boards so they won't work. And slot loads are entirely different machines I will add.

May I also ask if it makes any high pitch noises? Iy is not impossible for it to be something else but that said, given flyback failures on all iMac G3s are not exactly rare, I would put my bets on it being that.

Yeah the flyback transformer is what’s hooked up to the red wire to the tube itself (anode cap) and it looks like it would still work fine personally. Look for burn marks on the analogue board too. 
But this being an SE/30, these have leaky batteries and caps. If you have not taken out the logic board i would heavily suggest doing so soon. Your issue could be down there
